item.title: Capcom's New Year Sale offers up deals on Street Fighter 6 DLC, Capcom Fighting Collection 2 and more
item.description: <p>2026 is now finally upon us all, but that doesn't mean the New Year's celebrations need to stop.</p> <p>Despite the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/18/steam-winter-sale-fighters/">big Steam Winter Sale</a> being unfortunately over, Capcom is now running their own New Year Sale to offer up more fighting game discounts.</p>

item.title: Former Tekken boss reveals he's already been approached by an American defense company, a sushi chain and many more offers
item.description: <p>Tekken 8 is about to enter a new era without its longtime figurehead, and so is the former boss of the series.</p> <p>Katsuhiro Harada apparently has no shortage of job offerings after the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/08/katsuhiro-harada-departure-bandai-namco/">Tekken Director's sudden departure from Bandai Namco</a>.</p>

item.title: Early Evo Japan 2026 entrant numbers show just how big Street Fighter 6 is with more than double every other game combined
item.description: <p>Street Fighter 6 seems to be continuing its trend of being the biggest fighting game around, and that's especially true in Japan.</p> <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/09/evo-2026-game-lineup/">Evo Japan 2026</a> opened up its registration to the public a month ago, and the disparity between entrant numbers is honestly a bit staggering.</p>

However, they're at least keeping Mortal Kombat 1 updated with balance patches as promised while they <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/may/23/mortal-kombat-finished-characters/'>shift focus onto their next project</a>.</p> <p>It can be argued that the Kameo characters of Mortal Kombat 1 are just

item.title: Team Liquid distance themselves from fighting games as Nephew and Shadow20z become free agents
item.description: <p>In <a href="https://x.com/teamliquid/status/2008648029344330042">a recent X post</a>, Team Liquid announced that two of their players have now left their roster.</p> <p>While this is something that happens a lot in competitive gaming and with various sponsors, the notable fact here is that as Street Fighter player Nephew and Tekken competitor Shadow20z leave Team Liquid, it leaves them with no fighting game players left on their team roster.</p>

item.title: Capcom running New Year's survey that offers a special wallpaper with a new look at Ingrid in Street Fighter 6
item.description: <p>Capcom has been doing quite well for themselves in recent years, and they're looking to keep that momentum going moving into 2026 now.</p> <p>The company recently put together an end of year / New Year's survey to get some feedback from the fans.</p>
